acceptanceCriteria: corvint affected (or a documented lane recipe) yields a bounded local subset: changed packages, siblings and direct importers, with the cap and exclusions explicit
Lane charter and batch-integrator charter cite that subset as required before push
Measured on the next 10 batches: share needing a second CI run for a deterministic failure below 20%
body: Observed 2026-10-21. Lane charters asked for focused tests only. Deterministic failures in packages next to, or importing, the changed code (for example internal/liveverify/affected/{shell,cfamily} tests broken by DLT-V0-002's OpenBounded requirement, and the companionrelease workflow_smoke usage string) first surfaced in batch CI. 11 of about 24 batch PRs needed at least two full CI runs of about 31 minutes each. Interim mitigation: charter 1021e adds affected-selected siblings and direct importers (cap 15, skip cmd/corvint unless directly changed), and the integrator charter adds a preflight list.

completion.reason: Already delivered on main by e66a5bf30 (AFP-V0-162); lane affected-1021n verified against ef2a01db5 (PR #1469 report).

title: Lanes skip tests of sibling packages and direct importers, so batch CI finds deterministic failures (11 of ~24 batches needed 2+ 31-minute runs)
